name: cxr_segmentation_tool
description: Segment anatomy/lesions in a 2D chest X-ray via a configurable segmentation backend (local torchvision checkpoint, remote API, or deterministic fallback); returns a colored region overlay and per-region area fractions.

help.summary: Run CXR segmentation and overlay region masks (e.g. lungs, heart) with area fractions.

options.name: targets
options.description: Comma list of regions to segment.
